Platform badge artwork comes from the projects represented by each badge:

- [Solaris wordmark](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Oracle_Solaris_logo.svg)
- [illumos logo](https://illumos.github.io/docs/assets/images/illumos.svg)
- [DragonFly BSD logo](https://www.dragonflybsd.org/images/DragonFly_BSD.svg)
- [OmniOS logo](https://omnios.org/OmniOSce_logo.svg)
- [OpenIndiana bird](https://www.openindiana.org/oibird.svg)
- [Tribblix prompt mark](https://tribblix.org/)

The badges embed vector artwork locally so their logos do not depend on
third-party badge services recognizing a platform's name.
